The docs are also published as markdown (index.html.md pages for services, API reference and quickstart), and a Skills resource targets coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or complete markdown coverage (the /app/documentation.md path returned 404), and no independent hands-on report of agents consuming these docs.
